content.text: In Nigeria, Gumroad blocks creators. In Venezuela, PayPal rejects transactions. In Zimbabwe, currency collapse makes Stripe impossible. No platform fees. No subscriptions. No reliance on third-party infrastructure. This is base-layer architecture — built to withstand the exact conditions that locked you out.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway for digital products is not a workaround. It is a complete commerce infrastructure stack. The core components are hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, and payment processing. Each piece is selected for sovereignty: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting (free), Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic (free), Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage (free), Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery (free), and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification (0.5% fee only). The customer owns the entire stack after deployment. No platform has access. No subscriptions. Lifetime ownership.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The buyer selects a product priced in USD. The system converts this to the chosen cryptocurrency at the current exchange rate. NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain. Once confirmed, a webhook triggers the backend logic. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles the order. The product file is delivered instantly from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Order details are logged in Supabase or Google Sheets. The entire process is automated. No manual intervention required. The creator retains 99.5% of the sale — compared to Gumroad’s 90% retention. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, this retains $921 more per month.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and similar platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. Nigeria. Ghana. Kenya. Pakistan. Bangladesh. Ethiopia. Venezuela. Zimbabwe. Cameroon. Tanzania. Philippines. If you’ve been locked out of conventional payment platforms, this is your base-layer infrastructure. It is pressure-tested against actual payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation. It is not a startup solution. It is enterprise-grade architecture built for the people Stripe locked out.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction — compared to Gumroad’s 10%. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, this retains $921 more.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both are free and globally distributed. Backend Logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Both handle order processing and file delivery automatically. Order Storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. Both log transaction details securely. File Delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Both serve files instantly. Payment Processing: NOWPayments. Supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer account required. Recommended networks for low fees: BSC, Solana, TRON — under $0.10 per transaction. Each component is selected for sovereignty, cost, and reliability.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Both are deployed in 48 hours. The Starter Stack uses GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments. The Edge Stack uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Both include product loading, testing, and 30-day support. For complete documentation, purchase the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) or the Complete Builder Kit ($197). The Builder Kit includes all 6 blueprints, all 7 templates, and instant download. It is everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack. Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This architecture processes payments automatically, delivers products instantly, and gives you full data ownership. No platform fees. No subscriptions. Lifetime access.
The customer owns the entire stack after deployment. No platform has access. No subscriptions. Lifetime ownership.

If you’re selling notion templates for USDT or Bitcoin, or need a digital download store that accepts crypto only, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and all 7 templates. It is everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Instant download. Worth $348 separately. Available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Provide product details and pricing in USD. Select your preferred cryptocurrencies for payment (BSC, Solana, TRON recommended for low fees). Deploy the stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Set up order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. Upload product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. Test end-to-end: Place a test order, verify payment, and confirm file delivery. Launch your store and start selling.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack are deployed for you in 48 hours. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates and blueprints for non-developers. All components are designed for ease of use.
What happens if cryptocurrency prices fluctuate?
NOWPayments converts the USD price to the chosen cryptocurrency at the current exchange rate. The buyer pays the equivalent amount in crypto. You receive the full USD value minus the 0.5% fee.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually by sending the equivalent cryptocurrency back to the buyer. The system does not automate refunds. Document your refund policy clearly for buyers.
Can I sell physical products with this stack?
No. This stack is designed for digital products only. Automated file delivery via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script is optimized for ebooks, courses, templates, and software.
What if I need to scale beyond 100 products?
The Edge Commerce Stack includes scaling documentation. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook. Both provide guidance for expanding your product catalog and handling increased traffic.
